text:
Sam Chen: Hey Redwood! I'm Sam Chen, joining Product Infra as SRE. First day remote — super excited to be here :tada: Quick question for the team: what do people want for the welcome lunch on Friday? I'm team pineapple on pizza (controversial) :pineapple: :pizza:

Maya L: Welcome Sam!! :tada: Friday lunch sounds great. I'm vegan so would love a clear vegan option.

Carlos R: Welcome! +1 to lunch. Hawaiian is fine by me (also will defend it). FYI parking on 2nd floor is free after 6pm if you ever come by late.

Priya K: Hi Sam — welcome aboard! One small onboarding tip: request badge access in Okta > Resources and then choose "Badge pickup". Ping me if it doesn't show up.

onboarding-bot: New hire checklist created and assigned to @Sam Chen. Welcome to Redwood!

Sam Chen: Thanks all! OK let's do a tiny emoji poll — drop an emoji below to vote: :pizza: = pizza, :sushi: = sushi, :salad: = salad.

Maya L: :salad:

Carlos R: :pizza:

Jonathan P: :sushi: (but I will tolerate pineapple on pizza for Sam)

Priya K: :pizza: (also will bring extra napkins, safety first)

Alex W: Welcome Sam! If you want a buddy for week 1, ping me — happy to pair on infra quirks. Also we have a low-effort watercooler memes channel if you need lunchtime entertainment.

Sam Chen: Thanks Alex — I'll take you up on the buddy offer. Also — morning standup time preference check: I'm PST and 10:30am PT works best for me, does that fit others?

Maya L: 10:30 works for me.

Carlos R: works for me too.

Priya K: perfect.

Sam Chen: Awesome, I'll schedule 10:30 PT for the first week. Also unironically pro-pineapple :pineapple:

Priya K: :laughing: noted and recorded.

onboarding-bot: Reminder for @Sam Chen — badge pickup scheduled Tue at 3:00 PM.

Sam Chen: Thanks everyone — excited to meet folks in person soon!
